about_the_game:
Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

Use whatever garbage you can grab to sabotage your rivals. Throw trash to knock opponents off balance, discover unique projectiles with special properties, and do the party in the junkyard!

FEATURES

  • CHAOTIC MULTIPLAYER: Local competitive gameplay for 2-4 players

  • PHYSICS-BASED MADNESS: Every piece of trash follows super hyper mega realistic physics for unpredictable and hilarious results

  • RACING: Go fast and win

  • UNIQUE PROJECTILES: Master different trash items with special properties

  • DYNAMIC ENVIRONMENTS: Navigate shifting trash piles and environmental hazards that change every match

  • CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION: Unlock and customize your vermin with skins and HATS

  • MULTIPLE ARENAS: Battle across different trash-filled environments, each with unique challenges

  • ACCESSIBLE FUN: Easy to learn, difficult to master

Will you claim the crown or drown in defeat? Gather your friends and find out who's the true Royal Vermin!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz dual-core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible card with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.5, or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (3.0 GHz quad-core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 compatible card with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
